title: Benchmarking and Bridging Emotion Conflicts for Multimodal Emotion Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on a newly curated benchmark (CA-MER) featuring samples with conflicting emotional cues between audio and visual modalities, and analyzing intermediate attention patterns using a metric called Unimodal Attention Proportion (UAP) to quantify the model's over-reliance on audio tokens over visual tokens.
